287335
echo "===== 部署连接探针 link_probe.py 287335 $(date '+%F %T') ====="
echo "[1]写插件:"
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /root/bot/bot/plugins/link_probe.py
/root/bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile /root/bot/bot/plugins/link_probe.py && echo "  语法OK md5=$(md5sum /root/bot/bot/plugins/link_probe.py|cut -c1-8)" || { echo "  语法失败中止"; exit 1; }
echo "[2]平滑重启bot(当前未登录,不影响使用):"
OLDPID=$(pgrep -f '/root/bot/venv/bin/python main.py' | head -1)
echo "  旧bot PID=$OLDPID"
kill "$OLDPID" 2>/dev/null; sleep 3
( cd /root/bot/bot && setsid nohup /root/bot/venv/bin/python main.py >> /root/bot/bot/bot.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & )
sleep 12
NEWPID=$(pgrep -f '/root/bot/venv/bin/python main.py' | head -1)
echo "  新bot PID=$NEWPID"
echo "[3]确认插件加载+探针日志:"
grep -i "连接探针\|link_probe" /root/bot/bot/bot.log 2>/dev/null | tail -5 || echo "  日志暂无探针字样"
echo "  link_probe.log:"; tail -5 /root/link_probe.log 2>/dev/null || echo "  尚无link_probe.log"
echo "[4]确认bot无报错退出:"
ps -p "$NEWPID" -o pid,etime,cmd 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || echo "  进程不在!"
echo "=====完====="
